output.subject: Request to review the deductions on claim settlement
output.facts: The patient was admitted from 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-08 for fracture of neck of right femur and underwent right hip hemiarthroplasty. Upon discharge, the hospital submitted the final bill under policy rules. The insurer issued a settlement letter dated 2026-11-02, approving an amount of {{letter.approved}} out of the claimed amount of {{letter.claimed}}, while making erroneous deductions.

items.argument: The insurer incorrectly deducted registration charges (line 12) as a non-payable item. Under Non-payable items: Annexure I, Lists I to IV (IRDAI_NON_PAYABLE_ANNEX_I) and policy:8.1, administrative fees like registration are not subject to separate disallowance unless explicitly restricted. We request you to reverse this deduction and release the amount of {{flag.SUBSUMED_ITEM.recoverable}}.

The insurer has incorrectly applied a proportionate deduction to ICU charges (line 2), pharmacy and medicines (line 6), and laboratory and radiology (line 7). According to Norms on proportionate deductions (IRDAI_PROP_DED_2020) and policy:4.3, pharmacy, diagnostics, and ICU charges are expressly excluded from associated expenses subject to proportionate scaling. Therefore, the deduction is unjustified, and we request the release of {{flag.PROP_WRONGLY_APPLIED.recoverable}}.

output.relief: We request you to review these deductions and disburse the total recoverable amount of {{totals.recoverable}} at the earliest. As per the Insurer grievance resolution timeline (INSURER_GRIEVANCE_15D), we expect a written response to this grievance within 15 days.
